metadata.title: आदिवासी सीटों पर BAP का क्लीन स्वीप होगा - राजकुमार रोत | Interview: Rajkumar Roat
metadata.description: Raj Kumar Roat became an MLA at the age of 25 in year 2018. He was elected from Chorasi assembly seat in Rajasthan. His tenure as an MLA was quite eventful and he gathered attention of the media regularly. He has joined a new party Bharat Adivasi Party recently. Watch this interview with him.
